pages.message: Revenue grew 9.4% a year to $203.4m while on-time departures rose to 96.1%

exhibits.reader_must_see: the three operating figures for 2025 beside 2024, and which way each moved
exhibits.comparison: each metric in 2025 against the same metric in 2024
exhibits.data: three metrics by two years, mixed units (dollars, a count, a percent)

forms_considered.reason: chosen: mixed units sit in one grid and each row reads across
three figures alone lose the year they are compared with

exhibits.why: a reader checks each figure against last year, which a two-column grid shows without arithmetic
exhibits.marks: nothing on the table: the title states the claim and the left column explains it

pages.message: Revenue rose every year from $142.0m to $203.4m
pages.deliberate_parallel: the growth page sets its evidence beside its words as the summary does, so the two read as one argument

exhibits.reader_must_see: that revenue rose in each of the five years, and by how much in total
exhibits.comparison: each year's revenue against the year before it
exhibits.data: one series of five yearly values in dollars millions

forms_considered.reason: chosen: five ordered values read as heights against one baseline
five points draw a line, but the yearly amounts are the figures the reader quotes
the reader would compare numbers instead of seeing the rise

exhibits.why: the rise is a sequence of heights; labelled columns show it and carry the figures
exhibits.marks: values on every column; the 2025 column in the ochre accent where the claim ends

pages.message: North Sound carries 30% of revenue; the four routes total $203.4m

exhibits.reader_must_see: each route's revenue and passengers, and that they add up to the year's total
exhibits.comparison: the four routes against each other and against the total
exhibits.data: four routes by two measures, revenue in dollars millions and passengers in thousands, with a total

forms_considered.form: table of routes with a totals row
forms_considered.reason: chosen: two measures and a total that ties out read in one grid

forms_considered.form: horizontal bar chart of route revenue
forms_considered.reason: shows the ranking but drops passengers and the total

exhibits.chosen_form: table of routes with a totals row
exhibits.why: the reader looks the figures up and checks they sum to the total, which a table does directly
exhibits.marks: the totals row set bold under a rule
